description: Na₂MgMnP₂O₇F₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.58 Å. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.90 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.80 Å. Mg is bonded to three O and one F atom to form MgO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with four PO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.05 Å. The Mg-F bond length is 2.03 Å. Mn is bonded to three O and two F atoms to form MnO₃F₂ square pyramids that share corners with three PO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.08 Å. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to three O and one F atom to form PO₃F tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₃F₂ square pyramid and corners with two equivalent MgO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.54 Å. The P-F bond length is 1.70 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₃F₂ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent MgO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.60 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one P atom.
